description: This file defines the 'Blip' class which manages raw image data within the Escher drawing group in PhpSpreadsheet. It includes methods for setting and retrieving the image data and its parent BSE object.

classes.name: Blip
classes.description: Represents a Blip, managing raw image data within the Escher drawing group, with references to its parent BSE object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the raw image data stored in this Blip.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the raw image data for this Blip.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Assigns the parent BSE object to this Blip.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent BSE object associated with this Blip.
